These files verify the release-draft checker against a real detached GPG
signature. `public-key.asc` is a disposable test key, unrelated to the
production signing key. Its private key was deleted after fixture generation.

`SHA256SUMS.asc` signs the four Linux checksum lines generated by
`fixture()` in `test/stable-release.test.js`. The package contents are synthetic
bytes; this fixture does not establish platform code signing or installability.
Tests require `gpg` and `gpgv`, but no private key, agent, network, or signing
secrets. Ubuntu CI runners provide these tools; on macOS install GnuPG to run
the full checks.
